messages:
Zara: ok team, dashboard just crossed 200M ARR. gonna need a bigger confetti cannon. celebration tonight at 9? ramen relay + neon sticker drop? :tada: :ramen:

Ethan: 200M??? wild. ramen relay sounds amazing. i'll bring extra chopsticks and a tiny gong. :gong: :chopsticks:

Pri: massive congrats!!! shoutout to the autoscaler tweaks that kept p99 stable. engineers of the hour. :raised_hands: :rocket:

Mason: poll time  vote with emoji: :ramen: ramen bowls, :sushi: sushi bites, or :taco: street tacos. also drop allergy notes. poll closes in 8m.

Yui: Ops-bot FYI can you reserve the rooftop at 9 and log catering drop at 8:30?

Ops-bot: Event created: "200M Ramen Relay & Neon Stickers" 910pm Rooftop. Capacity 45. Catering: ramen bar + small sides. (automated)

Kara: stickers are printed neon holographic set. volunteers to fold & bag at 8:15? need 4 people.

Zara: tiny merch idea  limited-run glow-in-the-dark pins. who wants one? react with :sparkles: and we'll reserve.

Ethan: i'll help pack swag. also rapper-style airdrum performance optional.

Pri: meme drop: "me at 2am increasing batch size -> wakes up to 200M" [img] :joy:

Mason: tally so far  :ramen: 11, :sushi: 3, :taco: 2. ramen wins. ordering proceeds. :ramen:

Yui: logistics note: caterer needs loading dock clear at 8:20. please use visitor parking if driving in.

Kara: remote folks we'll mail stickers/pins if you drop addresses in #people-ops. we'll also livestream the tiny gong strike.

Zara: one-line shoutouts please so i can include in the toast slide: i'll start  "huge thanks to infra, autoscale, and release for late-night heroics."

Ethan: "bench team for catching that perf regression early."

Pri: "QA and docs for rapid playbook updates."

Mason: "vendor ops for same-day ramen bar pivot."

Yui: "customer success for smoothing the top-line calls, plus legal for greenlight."

Zara: perfect. see you at 9 for tiny ramen bowls, neon stickers, and a ceremonial gong. bring a sweater  rooftop gets chilly. :necktie: :confetti_ball:
